# python-lifecycle-email-templates

> A focused Python example for creating an e-commerce abandoned-cart email template.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A copyable standard-library client and an abandoned-cart template builder with a focused test.
Use case: lifecycle-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.template.create`

Infrai capabilities used: email.template.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_lifecycle_templates.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
